title: Actress Margarita
about: Said to show Marguerite, the French actress from the story of the million roses.

title: Giraffe
about: A single animal set against the dark ground, quiet and monumental.

title: Lion
about: A calm, almost heraldic lion, its body laid flat against the night of the oilcloth.

title: Roe Deer
about: A small deer alone in a dark landscape, one of his many solitary animals.

title: Mother and Son
about: A village mother and child, painted frontally with the stillness of an icon.

title: Donkey Bridge
details: State Museum of Fine Arts, Tbilisi
about: Ordinary traffic on a bridge, turned into a long and solemn frieze.

about: An open-air feast, the kind of scene he painted for the walls of taverns.

title: Ortachali Beauty
about: A woman from Ortachali, the garden district of old Tiflis known for its revelry.
